name: direct-write-path-pairs-after-commit
body: Admission no longer pre-flights edge pairing on the direct `write_project`/`apply_change` path either, because that path routes through `validate_change` → `validate_change_over`: an unpaired direct mutation is now caught only by `ingest_nodes`' full-set check after the durable commit, not before it. Upgrade by giving the direct path its own save-boundary call if a non-session writer is ever reintroduced; the session path is unaffected because `Coordinator::save` pairs the held set before writing.
